description: Use this when the person asks what Evictions API is, what is available today, how a real case is handled or who operates it. Takes no input. Returns the service’s description, its current status and who operates it, in the site’s own words, with links to the home and how-it-works pages. Do not use this for fees (use evictions_get_pricing) or for one state’s rules (use evictions_get_state_eviction_facts). No key needed.
name: evictions_get_service_overview
title: Service overview
